Liquor Scam: ED Files Chargesheet Naming Congress Leader

In Raipur, the Enforcement Directorate (ED) has filed another chargesheet in connection with a ₹3400 crore liquor scam. The chargesheet claims that ₹52 crore was channeled to Congress leader Ramgopal Agarwal. The ED has submitted this additional chargesheet.
